        s = 0
        for n in route:

        for i in range(len(route) - 1):

        s = 0
        for n in route:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

        for i in range(len(route) - 1):

        return c

                owner[(r[-1], 1)] = ri
                idx[r[0]] = ri
                idx[r[-1]] = ri

                cand_cost = delta
                pos = 0

                best_pos = None
                # insert at beginning

                best_delta = delta

                    b = r[k + 1]
                    delta = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b] - matrix[a][b]
                    if best_delta is None or (delta, node) < (best_delta, r[k] if r else -1):

                        best_pos = k + 1
                # insert at end
                delta_end = matrix[r[-1]][node] + matrix[node][depot] - matrix[r[-1]][depot]

                if (delta_end, node) < (best_delta, 10**18):

                    best_pos = len(r)
                cand_cost = best_delta

        return best

    for ri, r in enumerate(routes):
        node_to_route[r[0]] = ri

    # Prepare savings list
    # Deterministic sort: (savings desc, tie by i,j)
    savings = []
    depot_row = matrix[depot]
    # restrict to nearest neighbors if provided to speed
    nn = instance.get("nearest_neighbors", {})

        use_nn = True

        # We'll build savings only for directed pairs from nearest neighbor lists
